description: Horizon, Minecraft: Java Edition rewritten in Rust, as a native Switch 2 build at 1080p and 120 Hz with Joy-Con 2 mouse controls. Needs your own Minecraft: Java Edition, prepared on a PC.

notes: Minus toggles the F3 debug screen; Options, Horizon Settings, Overlay shows the FPS and frame graph.
Joy-Con 2 mouse mode: the right Joy-Con points (R breaks, ZR places, the right stick picks a block) while the left stick walks.

inputs.label: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 files, prepared by the Horizon Launcher from your own copy

files.note: The prepared files, with horizon-resources.json directly inside

prepare.summary: The Horizon Launcher (PC or Mac) prepares the game's files from your own Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, into .local/horizon-client/26.3/.

steps: On a PC or Mac, prepare your own Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 with the Horizon Launcher.
Copy the contents of .local/horizon-client/26.3/ into switch/horizon/resources/, so horizon-resources.json sits directly inside it.
Start horizon.nro with Title Override: hold R while opening a native Switch 2 title.
